section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess participants' characteristics and psychological constructs. Key measures include BMI (calculated from self-reported height and weight), the Figure Rating Scale (FRS) for body image discrepancy, the Cognitive Fusion Questionnaire-Body Image (CFQ-BI), the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). The text references 'two groups' and indicates that Cronbach's alphas for study variables are presented in Table 1, suggesting multiple samples, but the actual study design, sample characteristics, and results are not detailed in this section.
